info.title: yunq API
info.description: Static analysis platform: REST API, OAuth, signed webhooks and operational metrics.

get.summary: Read the audit trail of gate/profile/permission changes, newest first.

200.description: One page of audit log entries

get.summary: Return the user attached to the current yunq bearer session.
Finish OAuth login and exchange the provider code for a yunq bearer session.

400.description: Provider denied the request or parameters are missing

get.summary: Start an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with GitHub or GitLab.

307.description: Redirect to the provider authorization page

get.summary: Export ISO 32000-1 Binary PDF Compliance Report (Enterprise Subscription Required).
List the most recently detected security hotspots.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of hotspots to return (default 50, capped at 500).

put.summary: Record a reviewer's verdict on a hotspot.

post.summary:
Runs housekeeping immediately: deletes analyses past each project's
effective retention (its own override, else the instance-wide
`YUNQ_DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS` default, if set). The worker also runs
this on a timer (`YUNQ_HOUSEKEEPING_INTERVAL_HOURS`); this endpoint is
for an on-demand run or an external scheduler. Audit-logged as
`housekeeping.purged`.

get.summary: Search issues with filters and pagination (newest first).

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: Filter: exact rule id, e.g. owasp:eval-usage.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Filter: substring of the file path.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description:
Comma-separated facets to compute alongside the page:
severity, status, rule (e.g. `facets=severity,rule`).

post.summary:
Apply the same transition to many issues at once. Each issue succeeds or
fails independently — one illegal transition does not abort the batch.
Assign an issue to the AI Remediation Agent to automatically generate a verified fix.
post.description:
Runs the full verify-before-suggest loop: fetches the issue's real source
from GitHub, asks the LLM provider for a fix, applies it in an isolated
in-memory sandbox, and re-runs the analyzer. The proposal is only
returned if the original issue is gone and no new issue was introduced.

200.description: Verified AI Remediation Agent proposal generated

422.description: No verified fix could be produced (source unavailable, or the fix didn't pass re-scan)

502.description: GitHub or LLM provider request failed

get.summary: The recorded workflow history of an issue (audit trail).

post.summary: Apply a workflow transition to an issue.

409.description: Transition not allowed from the current status

get.summary:
Generate SVG status badge for a project, reflecting the real outcome of
the last persisted quality gate evaluation (green "passed", red "failed",
grey "no analysis" for a project that hasn't been scanned yet).

The most recently persisted coverage summary for a project, if any
report has been ingested yet.

404.description: No coverage report ingested yet for this project

post.summary:
Ingest a coverage report (raw file content as the request body) against
a project's most recent analysis.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Report format: lcov, cobertura, jacoco, llvm-cov, istanbul. Auto-detected from content when omitted.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch of the analysis the coverage report attaches to (default "main").

requestBody.description: Raw coverage report content (LCOV, Cobertura, JaCoCo, llvm-cov or Istanbul)

404.description: No analysis exists yet for this project/branch — run a scan first

put.summary:
Grant (or change) a user's fixed role on a project; audit-logged as
`permission.granted`. No groups, no templates, no SSO — a single role
per (project, user).

delete.summary: Revoke a user's role on a project; audit-logged as `permission.revoked`.

put.summary:
Sets (or clears) a project's analysis-history retention override, in
days; audit-logged as `project.retention_updated`.

Create or update a named quality gate's condition set; audit-logged as
`gate.updated`.

Create or update a named quality profile's rule activations;
audit-logged as `profile.updated`.

get.summary: The catalog of every rule this server's analyzers ship with.

post.summary: Enqueue a scan job for asynchronous analysis.

get.summary:
Operational snapshot: build version, uptime, DB reachability and a few
cheap counters — everything already available from server state or one
indexed count query each, nothing that scans a table.
Export process, HTTP, OAuth and webhook metrics in Prometheus text format.
List webhook subscriptions without exposing their signing secrets.
Read the bounded delivery-attempt log, including retry and terminal outcomes.

parameters.name: delivery_id
parameters.description: Filter all attempts for one delivery id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum records to return (default 100, capped at 1000).

post.summary: Queue an event for all subscribed webhooks or one selected registration.

verified.description:
Always true: only fixes that survive the generate→sandbox→re-scan→
verdict loop (the target issue is gone and no new issue appeared)
are ever returned by this endpoint.

assignee.description: User to assign; null/omitted to unassign.

resolution.description: Required when transition is `resolve`: fixed, wont-fix, false-positive.

transition.description: One of: confirm, resolve, reopen, close.

secret.description: Shared signing secret. It is never returned by the API.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) endpoint that will receive JSON POST requests.

event.description: Event name delivered in the `X-Yunq-Event` header and JSON envelope.

webhook_id.description: Optional registration id. When omitted, all subscribers receive it.

metric.description: Lowercase snake_case metric key, e.g. blocker_issues.

status.description: One of: to-review, acknowledged, fixed, safe.

ImpactDto.description: One MQR software-quality impact, serialized alongside the classic type.

oneOf.description: Present only when the request included a `facets` param.

severity.description: One of: info, minor, major, critical, blocker.

retention_days.description:
Days to keep this project's analysis history for, or `null` to fall
back to the instance-wide default (`YUNQ_DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS`, if
set — otherwise history is kept forever).

path.description: Path to the checked-out sources, reachable by a worker.

project.description: Project key the scan belongs to.

git_sha.description: `YUNQ_GIT_SHA` if the deploy set it, else "unknown".

pending_scan_jobs.description: Scan jobs still waiting for a worker to claim them.

resolution.description: Required when transition is `resolve`: fixed, wont-fix, false-positive.

transition.description: One of: confirm, resolve, reopen, close.
